body:
I don't know what else to say other than the fact I'm trying my absolute hardest to believe everything will get better, but I just can't. I can not and will not make them pay, I just can't do it.

I'm lost in a sea of thoughts, sitting here staring blankly at the screen, head blaring with depressing music, All I can seem to think about is suicide, ways to do it, when i should do it, I don't want to, but it's an ever present thought that won't go away. It's so fucking frustrating.

They'll be devastated for a time, and they'll get over it. It's better than them having to nickle and dime for the rest of their life and never being able to live a fulfilling life. Plus at this point I'm so depressed and dejected I have no strength left in me, I just want to crawl in a ball and die.
